clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore’s road, Sentinel Tysha Moonblade watches a troubled coast. The night elf scout stands west of Ameth'Aran, guiding travelers and seeking help with the restless spirits haunting the nearby ruins.

Sentinel Tysha Moonblade watches the road through Darkshore. East of her lie the ruins of Ameth'Aran, where cursed Highborne ghosts and malevolent banshees linger among ancient stone pillars. Auberdine's defenses are stretched thin by dangers along the coast, so Tysha asks capable travelers to uncover the history of Ameth'Aran's fall and put down its restless dead.
